validation.note: Opening-day roster assignment so offseason change exists in training. Special-teams features were built and tested (prior-season PP/PK goal rates from stints + skater counts). They improved points RMSE on both folds but fitted NEGATIVE coefficients -- the league's worst penalty kill gained +5 projected points -- which is a conditional regression artifact on 62 team-seasons, not special-teams skill. Not promoted. The SOAI replay is 5v5-only, so player-level PP/PK value cannot be tested here at all.

playoffs.methodology_note: Qualification, exact division/wildcard position and playoff advancement are simulated jointly across the complete released schedule. Every team with a non-zero path is retained in each bracket slot probability bar. The adjacent decision-specific qualification probability is kept separate because its richer role/fantasy feature set was validated for making the playoffs, not for individual game outcomes.
